contentHtml:
Computer taking an age to boot, whirring away oddly, or nagging about updates you never have time for? I run scheduled tune-ups and security hardening, onsite or remotely, so home users, freelancers and small offices around Stretton and Brisbane stay up and running instead of waiting for something to break.

Skipped maintenance catches up with every computer

Like a car that misses its services, a computer left without any care slows down, overheats and picks up malware that costs you time and money. A regular going-over, dusting out the insides, patching the security gaps and trimming the bloated software, keeps it fast, safe and out of trouble.

What is included

  • Hardware clean-out. Dust cleared from the fans and vents, and thermal paste renewed where it needs it, so it stops overheating and throttling.
  • Security hardening. Updates and patches applied, a malware sweep run, and the settings tightened up.
  • Performance boost. Startup programs trimmed, junk cleared, and the machine tuned so it feels responsive again.
  • Backup verification. I check your backups actually restore, not just that a backup job exists, which is where most people get caught out.

Want a one-off rather than an ongoing plan? See my computer tune-up service. If something nasty has already got in, there is virus and spyware removal, and to protect your files, data backup and transfer.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
